algebraic_review.direct_descent: Correct coefficientwise inequality is G'=2 >= (2/3)(G-zG')=2/3 for G=1+2z; product rule yields the stated lower bound for (j+1)M_(j+1)/M_j. The route's displayed right-hand coefficient vector (2/3,2/3) is incorrect; it should be (2/3,0).
algebraic_review.contract_index: For q_v(j)=[z^j](I(H_v)-I(R_v)), the contract summand at Delta_(p-1) equals q_v(p)-q_v(p-1), not q_v(p-1)-q_v(p-2). Summing q_v=zR gives the route's final expression R_(p-1)-R_(p-2).
algebraic_review.ulc_import: Gurvits, arXiv:0804.1181, Definition (2), Theorem 1.1, Remark 1.2: finite-order ULC permits normalization order at least degree and convolution adds orders. Strict Poisson inequalities on each finite factor permit all sufficiently large orders; taking the finite coefficientwise limit gives Poisson ULC. This is an informal proof, not kernel checked.
